# Avonstowe

> Avonstowe is a quantity surveying and forensic quantum practice for construction and engineering projects and disputes, across the United Kingdom, the Middle East and North Africa.

Avonstowe is a quantity surveying and forensic quantum practice. We work out what construction and engineering work is worth, and what is owed. On live projects, that means valuations, change and final accounts. In a dispute, it means rebuilding the figures from the project records and setting them out for adjudication, arbitration or settlement. We work across the UK, the Middle East and North Africa.

## Services
- Forensic quantum analysis: Quantum assessment, document review, analysis of project records and report drafting in arbitration, adjudication and litigation.
- Claims, disputes and commercial recovery: Prolongation, disruption, variations, loss and expense, final accounts and payment disputes, for employers, contractors and subcontractors.
- Quantity surveying and commercial management: Procurement, contract management, valuation, change control, cost forecasting and final account, under JCT, NEC, FIDIC and bespoke forms.

## Who does the work
- Michael Whiting, Principal. RICS Expert Witness Certificate; BSc (Hons) Quantity Surveying; Member, Society of Construction Law; LLB (Hons) (in progress); Diploma in Forensic Quantum Analysis (in progress).
- Michael advises on construction and engineering disputes across the United Kingdom, the Middle East and North Africa. His work covers quantum, commercial and contractual matters on live projects and in arbitration, adjudication and negotiated settlement. He entered the industry at sixteen with Balfour Beatty as an apprentice quantity surveyor, and that contractor-side background in procurement, live project delivery, valuation, change control, account reconstruction and final account negotiation is the foundation of his analysis.
- Career: Avonstowe 2022 to present; McLaren Construction 2019 to 2022; Balfour Beatty 2014 to 2019.
